thread:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT — P99 latency breach for customer Lumos (single-tenant)
pagerbot: Summary: p95 ~ 2.4s -> 4.8s, p99 peaked ~18s over the last 18 minutes. Streaming stalls observed on v-infer-rt pools handling Lumos traffic. Page sent to #oncall.
alice_ops: Got the page, looking. Can someone pull recent p95/p99 by route? suspect long prefixes + concurrent sessions.
ben_ml: I'm on it. Querying traces and stream stall logs now.
carla_sre: @alice_ops @ben_ml assigning incident lead to carla_sre for now. Incident channel = #incidents. Triage play: confirm impact, mitigate customer, roll fallback if needed, assess root cause.
david_se: Irene from support just flagged customer-side: Lumos started a batch of long-chain prompts with embedded transcripts ~20k tokens each. They ramped concurrency to ~380 concurrent requests. Might be correlated.
irene_support: Confirmed — Lumos engineer reported an A/B test with long prompts to stress a new summarization flow. They didn't expect streaming to choke.
ben_ml: Pulling trace for one stalled session... found repeated kvcache misses and a lot of memory alloc/reclaim on the inference host. Looks like KV cache growth + eviction thrash when many long prefixes interleave.
ben_ml: Metric snippets:
```
# from prometheus
redwood_infer_latency_ms{customer="lumos",quantile="0.95"} 4800
redwood_infer_latency_ms{customer="lumos",quantile="0.99"} 18000
redwood_infer_stream_stall_count{pool="v-infer-rt-1",customer="lumos"} 142
node_memory_used_bytes{instance="i-rt-03"} 11634567890
```
alice_ops: Streaming stalls show at the chunk flush stage — clients see timeout and retry, amplifying concurrency. Not seeing errors in model server itself (no OOM), but CPU on host spikes during KV cache compaction.
carla_sre: Immediate mitigations to reduce customer impact:
- throttle Lumos to 100 concurrent requests via per-customer rate-limit (apply now)
- disable streaming for Lumos (switch to non-streaming response for affected routes)
- enable fallback to quantized small model variant (model-v1-q4) for Lumos
- cordon and gracefully restart 2 nodes in v-infer-rt-1 if thrash persists
can someone run those? I'll coordinate.
david_se: Initiating rate-limit rule update: PATCH /policies/customer-rate-limits/lumos -> {"concurrency":100}
deploy-bot: deploy-job 4829 started by david_se
deploy-bot: rate-limit config rolled to edge proxies in 12s
irene_support: Notified Lumos support contact about temporary throttling and fallback; asked for ETA on stopping test traffic.
ben_ml: Rolling fallback now: route rewrite to model-v1-q4 for customer lumos on /generate endpoints.
deploy-bot: rollout 4830: model routing change to model-v1-q4 for customer lumos started
ben_ml: Also toggled stream=false in routing layer for lumos. This will cause slightly higher end-to-end p95 but avoids chunking stalls.
alice_ops: Watch metrics. If p99 stays high after throttling, we'll cordon nodes.
ben_ml: Quick observation: after throttling to 100 and switching model, p95 dropped to ~850ms within 40s. p99 currently ~2.1s. stream_stall_count -> 0 on observed hosts.
alice_ops: :thumbsup: good
carla_sre: OK, next: longer term remediation options captured here — create follow-up ticket. Suspected causes:
- single-tenant burst of long prefixes (KV cache growth > predicted)
- streaming buffer implementation not resilient to heavy interleaving of long sequences
- autoscaler didn't drain aggressively under tail latency pressure because of conservative policies
carla_sre: Follow-ups I want created:
- perf: add guardrails for KV cache size per-customer and eviction backpressure
- runtime: improve streaming chunk flush backpressure to avoid client retries loop
- infra: review autoscaler thresholds for single-tenant pools
- product: document guidance for customers running long-context stress tests
incident_manager: Assigned ticket INC-8421 to eng-runtime/perf, SLO/regression evals owners, priority P1 -> P2 after mitigation.
david_se: cordoning nodes: marking i-rt-02 for graceful restart to clear potential mem fragmentation
deploy-bot: restart job 4831 started for i-rt-02
alice_ops: While restart goes, let's capture heap/profile and kvcache stats. ben, can you drop a short script to collect top-k entries and eviction counts?
ben_ml: pushing a small script to /ops/debug/lumos_kvcache_snapshot.sh
```
#!/bin/bash
curl -s "http://inference-host:9001/debug/kvcache?customer=lumos&top=50" > /tmp/lumos_kv_top.json
curl -s "http://metrics:9090/api/v1/query?query=redwood_kvcache_evictions_total{customer=\"lumos\"}" > /tmp/lumos_kv_evictions.json
```
ben_ml: Snapshot shows a handful of very long prefixes holding large KV entries; eviction spikes correlate with request bursts.
carla_sre: Great. For the postmortem we'll need timelines, root-cause hypothesis, and exact mitigations. New oncall for next 2h is carla_sre -> handing off to carla at 1719237000.
carla_sre: Taking primary. @alice_ops @ben_ml keep me posted on node restarts and Lumos contact.
irene_support: Lumos responded — they paused the A/B test and apologized. They want a runbook for safe testing — we'll coordinate.
ben_ml: Early RCA hypothesis: single-tenant long-prefix storm caused KV cache thrash + streaming backpressure -> clients retried -> amplified concurrency -> tail blowups. Mitigation effective: rate-limit + fallback model + disable streaming for that customer until we have safe guardrails.
alice_ops: Post-incident tasks (short list):
- create perf ticket for kvcache guardrails (eng-runtime)
- add per-customer streaming disable flag in control plane (eng-platform)
- create alert: p99>10s for any single-customer with concurrent_requests>200 (ops)
- run load test simulating long-prefix interleaving (ben_ml)
incident_manager: Logging severity change: Sev2 -> monitor for 4h. Please update incident doc with timestamps and steps.
carla_sre: Thanks team. I'll stitch together a concise incident timeline and open follow-ups. Closing this thread when doc is up. :white_check_mark:
irene_support: Customer thanked us and requested a summary once the postmortem is ready.
alice_ops: Noted. Leaving monitoring on. If we see any recurrence, we escalate immediately.
pagerbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) — Lumos traffic back to stable after throttles and fallback. Please file postmortem within 72h.
carla_sre: Marking handoff complete — handing off to ben_ml for perf work at 1719237600.
